name: Ham Tien beach
kicker: Kite sand on the resort strip
summary: Kite beach on Ham Tien: learn in the morning, or ride 11:00–16:00 for the thermal wind. English Wikipedia calls this built beach Rang, in Ham Tien, the sand foreigners call Mui Ne Beach. The adventure page puts reliable kite wind at October to April and names IKO instructors on the main beach strip. The sports page says the breeze is year-round.
getThere: The beach in front of the Ham Tien strip.
heroCaption: A yellow kite on the wet sand, with the sea and a low ridge behind

notice.title: Morning for a first lesson
notice.body: The wind is gentler in the morning. The stronger thermal wind on the adventure page runs from 11:00 to 16:00.

body: The lesson beach is the Ham Tien sand, west of the fishing ward. A first lesson fits the gentler morning wind. From 11:00 to 16:00 the thermal wind is the stronger window, October to April, with IKO instructors on the main beach strip. The sports page says the breeze is year-round.

You draw out the lines, air the kite, strap in, and ride. Day passes at seaside properties are a separate beach day on the must-do list. Sleep on this strip if the wind is why you came, and give the harbor the other morning.

figures.caption: The kite up over the wash at Ham Tien
figures.alt: A kitesurfer holding a yellow kite above the water at Mui Ne beach

gettingThere: The built sand is Rang Beach in Ham Tien, the strip English Wikipedia says foreigners call Mui Ne Beach. It sits west of the fishing ward. The adventure page puts the IKO lessons on this main beach strip.

legs.heading: From the fishing ward
legs.body: The coast road west, onto the Ham Tien sand. The fishing ward, with Ganh and Suoi Nuoc, is the other end of the bay.

legs.heading: From Phan Thiet
legs.body: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu (ĐT 706) and Võ Nguyên Giáp (ĐT 706B) are the roads Vietnamese Wikipedia names into Mui Ne. The lesson beach is the Ham Tien sand at the end of that ride.

admissionNote: A lesson is separate from time on the sand. The adventure page names IKO instructors on the main beach strip. Day passes at beachfront properties are a separate charge. The must-do page says the morning wind is gentler. The sports page says the breeze is year-round.
